resources.string: You are on the latest version.
No release notes were provided for this version.
Comparing the SHA-256 checksum before installing.
Recommended action: check your internet connection and try again.
GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
GitHub limits anonymous update checks. Waiting a few minutes is enough.
No release has been published yet.
Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection.
The release version could not be read, so it was not offered.
The downloaded file did not match the published checksum. It was deleted and nothing was installed.
A mismatch can mean a corrupted download or a tampered file. SecureBox always refuses to install it.
This release has no checksum, so SecureBox refused to install it.
Without a checksum the app cannot prove the file is intact. Ask the maintainer to publish SHA256SUMS.
Android could not open the installer.
Android needs your permission before SecureBox can open the installer. SecureBox never installs anything silently.
